nodes.name: Wood aerogel preparation
nodes.procedure: Natural balsa wood was chemically processed (delignification) to partially remove lignin/hemicellulose, forming wood aerogel with much higher channel density and rich nanopits.

unit_operations.name: Delignification
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: very rich nanopits due to the partial removal of lignin/hemicellulose

nodes.source_text: Fig. S3. SEM image of wood aerogel, showing much higher channels density compared with that of natural balsa wood. Fig. S4. SEM image of the crosssection of wood aerogel displaying very rich nanopits due to the partial removal of lignin/hemicellulose.

nodes.name: NiP deposition on wood aerogel
nodes.procedure: NiP was deposited onto wood aerogel to form NiP/wood aerogel (Mo-0), showing homogenous distribution of Ni and P elements (Fig. S7).
nodes.source_text: Fig. S7. SEM images of NiP/wood aerogel (Mo-0) and corresponding EDS mapping images, showing the homogenous distribution of Ni and P elements.

nodes.name: NiMoP deposition on wood aerogel
nodes.procedure: NiMoP with different Mo contents (Mo-8, Mo-20) was deposited onto wood aerogel, showing homogenous distribution of Ni, Mo and P elements (Figs. S9-S12).
nodes.source_text: Fig. S9. SEM images of NiMoP/wood aerogel (Mo-20) and corresponding EDS mapping images. Fig. S11. EDS mapping images of NiMoP/wood aerogel (Mo-8).

nodes.name: OOH layer coating with activation
nodes.procedure: S,P-(Ni,Mo,Fe)OOH layer was coated on NiMoP/wood aerogel through activation process with different durations (2, 5, 10, 60 minutes) (Fig. S15).

unit_operations.name: Electrochemical activation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: prepared with different activation durations (2, 5, 10, 60 minutes)

nodes.source_text: Fig. S15. SEM images of S,P-(Ni,Mo,Fe)OOH coated on NiMoP/wood aerogel prepared with different activation durations.
